recommendations.description: API endpoint URL is hardcoded in todoApi.ts without environment variable configuration, exposing sensitive configuration details. This violates security best practices and prevents proper environment management.
Network errors in API service are not properly caught or handled, which could cause application crashes. All API methods need try-catch blocks or promise error handlers.
Network failure scenarios are completely untested in the API service layer. This is a critical gap that leaves the application vulnerable to production issues.
The TodoApp component uses complex nested state that could lead to mutations and difficult debugging. Consider migrating to useReducer or a custom hook for better state management.
Error handling paths in TodoApp are not tested, particularly for API failures during todo addition and deletion. These are critical user-facing scenarios.
API responses are not validated at runtime. The service assumes the server always returns the expected structure, which can cause runtime errors if the API changes.
Missing memoization and useCallback wrappers for event handlers passed to child components, which can cause unnecessary re-renders.
Extract complex state management logic from TodoApp into a custom useTodos hook to improve code reusability and testability.
